Build Your Dream Kitchen Cabinets! 🍳✨
Planning a kitchen makeover? 🏠💭 The right cabinets can make or break your cooking experience. From layout to shutter finish to hardware, every detail matters!
Here's what to know before you start 👇
🔲 Choose your layout – L-shaped, parallel, U-shaped, island or single-wall, pick what fits your space best

✨ Shutter finishes that shine – Acrylic, PVC, Laminate, Lacquer & Veneer for every style & budget

🪵 Strong foundations matter – Marine plywood & BWP boards keep cabinets moisture & termite-proof

⚙️ Hardware that lasts – Soft-close hinges, full-extension drawers, magic corners & tandem boxes

📐 Smart layout planning – Optimize your work triangle (sink-stove-fridge) for effortless cooking

🍽️ Don't forget storage extras – Pull-out pantry units & waste bin solutions for a clutter-free kitchen
A well-designed kitchen isn't just beautiful, it's built to perform for years! 💪🏠
At Spacewood, every kitchen comes with ISI-certified BWP plywood, premium European hardware & a 10-year structural warranty. 🛠️🏆

Transform Your Living Hall Today! 🛋️✨
Ready to give your living room the upgrade it deserves? 🏡💫 Whether you have a cozy 10×12 hall or a spacious open-plan living area, the right design choices can completely change how your space feels and functions.
Here's what makes a hall truly shine: 👇
🎯 Smart layouts with clear walking paths & focal points

🖼️ Stunning feature walls (TV units, textured panels & more)

🛋️ Seating that fits your room shape – L-sofas, 3+1+1 sets & more

💡 Layered lighting – ambient, task & accent for warm evening vibes

📦 Smart storage that hides clutter & keeps things sleek

🎨 Calm color palettes that stay timeless & budget-friendly
Whether you're working with a small hall or a large living room, small smart changes – like a statement light, a feature wall, or wall-mounted storage – can transform the entire vibe! 🌟
From layout planning to modular furniture solutions, Spacewood brings 30+ years of expertise to design halls that work as hard as they look good. 💪🏠

White Wardrobes: Timeless, Bright & Space-Expanding

Want a bedroom that feels bigger and brighter? White wardrobes reflect light so the unit never feels like a heavy wall — perfect for compact Indian bedrooms.

✨ 6 design directions to explore:
• Matte sliding & glossy lacquered finishes
• Two-tone white + wood for added warmth
• Mirror panels that double as a dressing mirror
• Floor-to-ceiling storage that maximises every inch

💡 Pro tip: Quality laminate finishes resist humidity and stay yellow-free for years.

Design your dream wardrobe with Spacewood today!

🪔 Designing a Pooja Room That Fits Modern Indian Homes

A sacred corner doesn't need a big footprint — just smart design. From wall-mounted units with glass shutters that save floor space to warm 2700K LED lighting that recreates a traditional glow safely, here's how to build a pooja room that honours tradition and fits apartment living.

✨ Inside the blog:
• Vastu-friendly placement & idol direction tips
• Space-saving designs for 1BHK–3BHK homes
• Durable materials for the Indian climate
• Common mistakes to avoid (like overcrowding!)

Create a serene space for daily rituals with Spacewood. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Venkatesh Kairamkonda
featured_reviews.review_text: We are repetitive customer for second time based on excellent quality experience from first one. We are highly impressed upon the quality of Kitchen and Wardrobes and essentially with cost effective. Spacewood has demonstrated that their HMR MDF & HDF versions are much cost effective in comparison to waterproof plywood with heavy material. Traditionally, heavy plywood with high costs are used every part of Kitchen & Wardrobe but essentially use of such heavy plywood is waste not having the need of waterproof. Therefore, Spacewood has brought a great solution with HMR MDF & HDF to use where exactly needed to save the cost by bringing the great quality. For Example, at below the sink where water dripping has chance, they use the HMR HDF and elsewhere MDF. Moreover, the heavy plywood shutters causes the lose of hinges but Spacewood's MDF has light weight by essentially improving the life of the product. Many Thanks for the technical demonstration by Dimple Sawkar. Also, highly appreciated to Nandini for her minute detailed drawings with atmost care of every essential comments made by us. After installation, there was not a difference of 1mm mismatch. What a great accuracy achieved by Spacewood team. During installation as well, in particular Akhilesh Vishwakarma put his efforts for all exact adjustments including the perfect leveling with his full satisfaction before calling the customer comments. Highly appreciated for the entire well co-ordinated towards the customer satisfaction approach by Design, Installation & Service team. Highly recommended for Spacewood's innovative solutions with cost effective with an added advantage of great looking including the aesthetic looks overview without even demands from the customers. Happy to have such solution provider's within the Industry. Not to forget that all internal parts used are of high quality including the hinges, gas spring, drawer roller and in particular the Spacewood's own developed Clamp system for perfect alignment of the cabinets with ease of installation. There was no compromise to chose such quality internal parts which are the brain of the product to improve it's life. Great Quality with optimum Cost and durability.
